global: Scientific-validity verdict: the inventories are mostly honest. Negative results (07.A FAIL, G08-3 FAIL, D-074 4/60, D7a==D1, P1 HANDBOOK_REVISION_REQUIRED, DIRECT 0.754%) are kept, UNKNOWN!=0 is repeated, and D-071 limits are respected (no AI signatures or nonces). The main systemic risk is §141 drift around the first SIMULATE. The AA pilot prereg makes SIM-VAL descriptive with no threshold, and only 4 papers exist against VAL-5's >=5 lab groups, so no model can be 'held-out validated' before 25 Nov. Every SIMULATE/sim_aa_1 number must therefore be RESEARCH_ONLY/NOT_VALIDATED/NON_CITABLE with §141 label physically_possible. Several MUST items (T0-C05-R3, T0-C06-R1/R2, T5-C11-R4, T5-C13-R3, T8-C08-R1) currently imply otherwise; my amendments fix that. Second risk: D-077 layer mixing downstream, in the mechanism screen (NOT_POSSIBLE from Layer 2 drivers), lot-state masses from SR portion defaults, a_w estimates and default durations. Each needs its basis carried and reported separately. Third: outcome-conditioned acceptance criteria (SIMULATE>0, '>=12/16 rows VERIFIED', '07.A PASS') must become process-based. Fourth: circular H3/H1 scoring (claim checker grades its own enforcement; S-block gold from the engine under test). T8-C16-R1 should be MUST. Factual corrections from repo evidence: Rung A is 9,470,190 events, while 14,594,812 is the 26g census total (T0-C03, T9-C16, T7-C17, and packet L137/L165 repeat the error). scenario_defaults_v1.csv has 27 rows, not 28. Status corrections: T9-C16 (validation NOT_STARTED) and T9-C28 (licences DRAFT, not DONE). T8-C19 'RUN' should be read as silver-dev only. The 07.A-R1 switch to Gwet AC1 is acceptable only as a recorded, pre-registered deviation on a fresh packet with v4 FAIL kept; T2-C05-R5 should be done before labelling. ECE must not be computed on the uncalibrated rule-based abstention score. Under the 35.0 guard, no Step 35 real-data run, descriptive or otherwise, happens before signature. reports/orchestration/review/ is empty and only S176_L-PH_report.md exists among lane reports; I used it as evidence that the FDA pH source was opened, so T3-C22-R2's source requirement is being met.
